title.zh-CN: 反复黑便、面色苍白 · 12岁男孩
title.en: Recurrent black stools and pallor · 12-year-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 一个12岁男孩黑便反复了八年，几家医院都没找到原因：先判断他眼下有多危险，再决定到哪里寻找出血部位，最后对照他的实际病程复盘。
summary.en: Eight years of recurring black stools in a 12-year-old boy, and no hospital has found the cause: judge how unwell he is now, decide where to look next, then compare your plan with his recorded course.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——12岁男孩，黑便、面色苍白反复 8 年（起病于一次低热后，伴脐周阵发性痛），近 1 个月再发；外院胃镜、结肠镜和腹部 CT 未明确原因，间断服用奥美拉唑和云南白药效果不佳；入院查体（重度贫血貌、心率 100 次/分、心前区 Ⅱ/6 级收缩期杂音、腹软、肝脾未触及、下肢无水肿）；血常规、粪便隐血、凝血功能和骨髓结果；异位胃黏膜显像、标记红细胞显像和增强 CT；先纠正贫血后行空肠部分切除吻合、手术所见、病理和术后恢复——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色、陪同的家属（具体是哪位亲属未记录）和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（除心率外的生命体征、红细胞指数、铁蛋白、纠正贫血的方法、手术细节、随访）保持未知。保留的不一致：CT 测得的肿块约 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm，术中所见为 5 cm × 3 cm × 3 cm（不同时间、不同测量方法，未作取舍）。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 12-year-old boy with eight years of recurrent black stools and pallor (beginning after a low-grade fever, with intermittent periumbilical pain), recurring over the last month; gastroscopy, colonoscopy and abdominal CT elsewhere without a cause; intermittent omeprazole and Yunnan Baiyao with little effect; the admission examination (severe pallor, heart rate 100/min, a grade II/6 precordial systolic murmur, soft abdomen, liver and spleen not palpable, no leg oedema); the blood count, faecal occult blood, clotting and marrow results; the ectopic gastric mucosa scan, the labelled red-cell scan and the contrast CT; correction of the anaemia followed by partial jejunal resection with anastomosis, the operative findings, the pathology and the recovery — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff, the accompanying relative (which relative is not recorded) and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs other than the heart rate, red-cell indices, ferritin, how the anaemia was corrected, operative details, follow-up) stays unknown. Inconsistency kept: the mass measured about 2.0 × 3.5 cm on CT and 5 × 3 × 3 cm at operation (different times and methods; neither reading is preferred).

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在胃镜、结肠镜和 CT 阴性而黑便反复时识别“疑似小肠出血”，并规划小肠检查：无狭窄时以胶囊内镜为一线、CT 小肠成像，以及儿童的异位胃黏膜显像（ESGE 2022；ACG 2015）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise suspected small-bowel bleeding when black stools recur after negative gastroscopy, colonoscopy and CT, and plan the small-bowel work-up — capsule endoscopy first-line when no narrowing is suspected, CT enterography, and a pertechnetate scan in a child (ESGE 2022; ACG 2015).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 处理代偿中的儿童慢性重度贫血（血红蛋白 28 g/L）：按体重小量分次缓慢输注红细胞、每次复评有无循环超负荷，之后补铁（NICE NG24，2015；BSH 2016）。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage chronic severe anaemia (haemoglobin 28 g/L) in a compensated child: weight-based red-cell aliquots run slowly with reassessment for circulatory overload after each, then iron replacement (NICE NG24, 2015; BSH 2016).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按各自能回答的问题解读定位检查：阴性的异位胃黏膜显像、标记红细胞显像上较固定的浓集，以及 CT 上门静脉期强化伴点状钙化的空肠肿块。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret localisation studies by what each can show: a negative ectopic gastric mucosa scan, a relatively fixed focus on a labelled red-cell scan, and a jejunal mass with portal-venous enhancement and punctate calcification on CT.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为孤立的出血性小肠血管病变制订确定性治疗——贫血纠正后切除病变肠段并一期吻合、术中检查全部小肠——并说明为什么不用放疗、普萘洛尔或内镜下烧灼（ESGE 2022；AAP 2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan definitive treatment of a solitary bleeding small-bowel vascular lesion — segmental resection with primary anastomosis once the anaemia is corrected, with the whole small bowel examined — and explain why radiotherapy, propranolol or endoscopic ablation are not the answer (ESGE 2022; AAP 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用 ISSVA 2018 分类理解病理名称“海绵状血管瘤”（血管肿瘤与血管畸形之分），并据此安排补铁、复发和多发病变的随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Relate the pathology label 'cavernous haemangioma' to the ISSVA classification (2018) of vascular tumours and malformations, and plan follow-up for iron repletion, recurrence and multifocal disease accordingly.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 向 12 岁的孩子和他的家属解释输血和手术的理由与风险，征得孩子本人的同意和家属的知情同意，并说明病历不能回答的问题。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the reasons for and risks of transfusion and surgery to a 12-year-old and his family, seeking his assent and their informed consent, and say what the record cannot answer.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 拉黑便、脸色发白，反反复复八年了，这一个月又来了
chiefComplaint.en: Black poo and looking pale, on and off for eight years, and it's back again this month

triageNote.zh-CN: 12岁男孩，黑便、面色苍白反复 8 年，近 1 个月再发，收入儿科病房。入院时心率 100 次/分。
triageNote.en: 12-year-old boy admitted to the children's ward with eight years of recurrent black stools and pallor, back again over the past month. Heart rate 100/min on admission.

personality.zh-CN: 12岁男孩，话不多，有点怕抽血和打针；被问到才回答，只说自己知道的，记不清的就直说说不上来，从不瞎猜。
personality.en: A quiet 12-year-old who is a little scared of needles; he answers what he is asked, says only what he knows, and when he can't remember he says so rather than guess.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子的日常口语，说“拉黑便”“肚脐周围疼”“脸发白”，不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: A child's everyday words — 'black poo', 'sore round my belly button', 'gone pale' — and no medical terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生好。我拉的大便又是黑的了，脸也发白。
openingLine.en: Hi, doctor. My poo's gone black again, and I've gone pale.

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是又要抽好多血、做好多检查啊？
concerns.en: Am I going to have loads more needles and tests?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：他躺在病床上，脸色很白，安静、有点紧张，说话简短；看到针头会缩一下。只回答被问到的内容，不提任何检查结果或数字，不编造病史、用药或过敏。家属陪在床边，但病史由他自己回答。手术之后的阶段，他说恢复得还行，别的说不上来。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: he lies in bed, very pale, quiet and a little tense, answering briefly, and flinches at needles. He answers only what he is asked, never mentions results or numbers, and never invents history, medicines or allergies. A relative sits at the bedside, but he answers his own history. After the operation he says he is getting on fine and cannot say more.

persona.zh-CN: 陪孩子住院的一位近亲属；具体是哪位亲属本病例没有记录，不要另加设定。担心孩子又这么苍白，话不多；病史让孩子自己说，被问到时请医生直接问孩子；签字同意前想先弄清楚输血和手术的风险；不补充病例没有记录的任何事。
persona.en: A close relative staying with him in hospital; which relative is not recorded, so add nothing. Worried to see him so pale again and says little; leaves the history to him and suggests the doctor ask him directly; wants to understand the risks of transfusion and surgery before signing; adds nothing the case does not record.

description.zh-CN: 他因为黑便、面色苍白又出现，收入儿科病房：采集病史、查体、查看入院化验，决定先处理什么、再到哪里寻找出血部位。
description.en: He has been admitted to the children's ward because the black stools and pallor are back: take his history, examine him, read the admission tests, and decide what comes first and where to look for the bleeding.

description.zh-CN: 住院期间按计划寻找出血来源：本阶段可调阅核素显像报告、完成腹部增强 CT，然后决定确定性治疗。
description.en: During the admission the search for the source goes ahead: read the nuclear medicine reports, get the contrast CT and decide on definitive treatment.

description.zh-CN: 贫血纠正之后他接受了手术，现在回到病房：调阅手术记录和病理报告，制订出院后的计划。
description.en: Once his anaemia had been corrected he had his operation and is back on the ward: read the operation note and the pathology report, and plan what follows discharge.

description.zh-CN: 查阅本病例记录的病程与转归；出院后的随访没有记录。
description.en: Review the course and outcome as recorded; follow-up after discharge is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：12岁男孩，黑便、面色苍白反复 8 年，近 1 个月再发。8 年前一次低热后出现黑便，伴脐周阵发性痛和面色苍白，此后反复；多家医院的胃镜、结肠镜和腹部 CT 未明确原因，间断服用奥美拉唑和云南白药效果不佳。入院时重度贫血貌，心率 100 次/分，心前区 Ⅱ/6 级收缩期杂音，腹软，肝脾未触及，双下肢无水肿；血红蛋白 28 g/L，红细胞 1.81×10¹²/L，血小板 363×10⁹/L，粪便隐血 ++，凝血功能正常，骨髓呈缺铁表现。异位胃黏膜显像阴性；标记红细胞显像见较固定的放射性浓集；腹部增强 CT 示空肠约 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm 肿块，门静脉期明显强化，伴点状钙化。先纠正贫血，再行手术：屈氏韧带远侧约 5 cm 处见 5 cm × 3 cm × 3 cm 暗红色结节状肿物，行空肠部分切除吻合术；病理为海绵状血管瘤伴出血及钙化。术后恢复良好。本病例没有记录纠正贫血的方法、出院用药、随访时长和此后是否再出血。
text.en: Recorded course: a 12-year-old boy with eight years of recurrent black stools and pallor, recurring over the last month. Eight years earlier, after a low-grade fever, black stools began with intermittent periumbilical pain and pallor, and recurred thereafter; gastroscopy, colonoscopy and abdominal CT at several hospitals found no cause, and intermittent omeprazole and Yunnan Baiyao helped little. On admission he looked severely anaemic, heart rate 100/min, with a grade II/6 systolic murmur over the precordium; abdomen soft, liver and spleen not palpable, no leg oedema; haemoglobin 28 g/L, red cells 1.81×10¹²/L, platelets 363×10⁹/L, faecal occult blood ++, normal clotting and an iron-deficiency marrow pattern. The ectopic gastric mucosa scan was negative; a labelled red-cell scan showed a relatively fixed focus of tracer; contrast-enhanced CT showed a jejunal mass of about 2.0 × 3.5 cm, enhancing markedly in the portal venous phase, with punctate calcification. The anaemia was corrected first; at operation a dark-red nodular mass of 5 × 3 × 3 cm lay about 5 cm distal to the ligament of Treitz and a partial jejunal resection with anastomosis was done; histology showed cavernous haemangioma with haemorrhage and calcification. He recovered well after the operation. This case records neither how the anaemia was corrected, nor the discharge medicines, the length of follow-up or whether he bled again.

dose.en: Weight-based aliquots (mL/kg, by the paediatric transfusion formula), each run slowly; after each, reassess heart rate, breathing, chest and liver size before the next, and stop at any sign of circulatory overload.

response.zh-CN: 第一份红细胞开始缓慢输注。本病例记录他在手术前先纠正了贫血，但没有记录纠正的方法（是否输血、用了哪种血制品、量和速度）；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The first aliquot of red cells is running slowly. This case records that his anaemia was corrected before the operation but not how (whether by transfusion, which product, how much or how fast); it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 红细胞 20 mL/kg，1 小时内输完，必要时重复，把血红蛋白尽快升到正常。
dose.en: Red cells 20 mL/kg over one hour, repeated as needed, to bring the haemoglobin back to normal quickly.

harm.zh-CN: 不要：缺铁的骨髓、八年反复出血加上这一个月的再发，提示贫血是慢慢形成的，血容量已经代偿性扩张；这时短时间大量输血最容易引起输血相关循环超负荷（急性肺水肿、心力衰竭）。NICE NG24（2015）对没有活动性出血的患者建议每次一个单位（儿童按体重折算等量）、每次输后复评；BSH 2016 儿童输血指南按体重计算输注量。不需要也不应该一下子把血红蛋白补到正常。
harm.en: No: an iron-deficient marrow, eight years of recurrent bleeding and a month of renewed loss point to anaemia that developed slowly, with an expanded plasma volume, and a rapid large transfusion is then the likeliest cause of transfusion-associated circulatory overload (acute pulmonary oedema, heart failure). NICE NG24 (2015) advises one unit at a time (a weight-equivalent volume in children) with reassessment after each when there is no active bleeding, and the BSH 2016 paediatric guideline calculates volumes by weight. There is no need to restore a normal haemoglobin at once.

response.zh-CN: 红细胞开始快速输注。本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The red cells are running in fast. This case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 元素铁按体重口服（每日 mg/kg 的治疗量，按国家儿童处方集，不超过成人剂量），血红蛋白恢复后继续数月以补足储备；用水或果汁送服，避免与牛奶同服。
dose.en: Elemental iron by mouth at a weight-based treatment dose (mg/kg/day per the national paediatric formulary, not above the adult dose), continued for some months after the haemoglobin recovers to refill the stores; with water or juice rather than milk.

response.zh-CN: 口服铁剂已开出。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Oral iron is prescribed. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 奥美拉唑按体重静脉给药（剂量按儿童处方集）。
dose.en: Omeprazole intravenously at a weight-based dose (per the paediatric formulary).

response.zh-CN: 已开出。本病例没有记录这次住院是否用过抑酸药；不模拟其效果。他以前间断口服奥美拉唑效果不佳；抑酸药针对的是胃十二指肠的消化性病变，而多次胃镜都没有找到出血原因。
response.en: Prescribed. This case does not record whether acid suppression was given this admission and does not simulate its effect. Intermittent omeprazole had already helped little; acid suppression treats peptic lesions of the stomach and duodenum, and repeated gastroscopy had found no cause there.

name.zh-CN: 带原来的药出院，门诊随访
name.en: Discharge home on his usual medicines with clinic follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 继续奥美拉唑和云南白药，加口服铁剂，门诊预约检查，黑便加重再住院。
dose.en: Continue omeprazole and Yunnan Baiyao with oral iron, book tests in clinic, and readmit if the black stools worsen.

harm.zh-CN: 不要：血红蛋白 28 g/L、粪便隐血 ++、出血来源还没找到，奥美拉唑和云南白药他已经间断用过、效果不佳。带着这样的贫血回家，再次出血时几乎没有代偿余地；他需要住院纠正贫血并检查小肠（ESGE 2022）。
harm.en: No: with a haemoglobin of 28 g/L, faecal occult blood ++ and the source still unknown — and omeprazole and Yunnan Baiyao already tried without benefit — the next bleed at home would find almost no reserve. He needs admission, correction of the anaemia and a small-bowel search (ESGE 2022).

response.zh-CN: 已安排出院。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Discharge arranged. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 向孩子和家属说明并取得同意
name.en: Explain and seek his assent and the family's consent

dose.zh-CN: 用孩子听得懂的话讲清输血或手术的理由、做法、风险和替代方案，征得孩子本人的同意和家属的知情同意并签字。
dose.en: Explain the reason, the procedure, the risks and the alternatives for the transfusion or the operation in words he understands, and obtain his assent and the family's signed consent.

response.zh-CN: 谈话已完成，签字同意书已存档。本病例没有记录谈话内容；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The discussion is held and the signed consent filed. This case does not record the conversation; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 小儿外科：择期切除病变空肠段并一期吻合
name.en: Paediatric surgery: elective resection of the affected jejunal segment with primary anastomosis

dose.zh-CN: 开腹或腹腔镜探查：切除含病灶的空肠段并一期吻合，术中检查全部小肠（有条件时术中内镜），切除标本送病理。
dose.en: Open or laparoscopic exploration: resect the jejunal segment containing the lesion with a primary anastomosis, examine the whole small bowel (intraoperative enteroscopy where available) and send the specimen for histology.

harm.zh-CN: 先纠正贫血再手术：血红蛋白 28 g/L 时，麻醉和手术期间的氧供储备极小，术中再失血就没有余地。他目前代偿、没有记录活动性大出血，没有理由在纠正贫血之前手术。
harm.en: Correct the anaemia first: at a haemoglobin of 28 g/L there is almost no oxygen-delivery reserve for anaesthesia, and none for blood lost in theatre. He is compensated and no active major bleeding is recorded, so nothing justifies operating before the anaemia is corrected.

response.zh-CN: 小儿外科已接手，计划在贫血纠正后手术。与报告一致：他在贫血纠正之后接受了空肠部分切除吻合术；手术所见和病理见下一阶段的记录。
response.en: The paediatric surgeons have taken him on, planning to operate once his anaemia is corrected. As in the report: after the anaemia had been corrected he had a partial jejunal resection with anastomosis; the findings and the pathology are in the next phase's records.

dose.zh-CN: 对空肠病灶做小剂量外照射，使其萎缩。
dose.en: Low-dose external-beam radiotherapy to the jejunal lesion to shrink it.

harm.zh-CN: 不要：放疗曾经用于血管瘤，如今已被弃用。照射儿童腹部会带来放射性肠炎、生长发育受损和远期第二肿瘤的风险，而一个孤立的出血病灶可以手术切除。按 ISSVA 2018 分类，这类慢血流血管畸形今天靠切除、硬化治疗或（病变广泛时）西罗莫司处理，没有放疗的位置。
harm.en: No: radiotherapy was once used for haemangiomas and has been abandoned. Irradiating a child's abdomen brings radiation enteritis, impaired growth and a later second-cancer risk, while a solitary bleeding lesion can be removed. Slow-flow malformations, as ISSVA (2018) classifies them, are managed today by excision, sclerotherapy or — when extensive — sirolimus; radiotherapy has no place.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录放疗，不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no radiotherapy and does not simulate one.

dose.zh-CN: 按婴儿血管瘤的用法，每日 2–3 mg/kg 分次口服。
dose.en: As for infantile haemangioma: 2–3 mg/kg per day by mouth in divided doses.

harm.zh-CN: 不要：普萘洛尔是需要治疗的婴儿血管瘤（婴儿期增殖的血管肿瘤）的一线全身用药（AAP 2019）；他 12 岁，肠道里的病变不是婴儿血管瘤。血红蛋白只有 28 g/L 时，他靠加快心率维持供氧，β 受体阻滞剂还会削弱这种代偿。
harm.en: No: propranolol is the first-line systemic treatment for infantile haemangiomas that need treatment — vascular tumours that grow in infancy (AAP 2019); at 12 years, the lesion in his bowel is not one. With a haemoglobin of 28 g/L he relies on his heart rate to deliver oxygen, and beta-blockade blunts that response.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录使用普萘洛尔，不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no propranolol and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 继续补铁至血红蛋白和铁蛋白恢复，出院后数周复查血常规；教会孩子和家属识别黑便和面色苍白，复发时及时回院并再次检查小肠；查看皮肤并询问有无其他血管性病变。
dose.en: Iron until the haemoglobin and ferritin have recovered, with a blood count a few weeks after discharge; teach him and his family to recognise black stools and pallor and to come back promptly for a further small-bowel look if they recur; examine his skin and ask about other vascular lesions.

response.zh-CN: 已列入出院计划。本病例记录术后恢复良好，但没有记录出院用药、复查和随访时长；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the discharge plan. This case records a good recovery after the operation but not his discharge medicines, check-ups or length of follow-up; it does not simulate their effect.

title.en: Take the story of the black stools

hint.zh-CN: 大便发黑，说明血大致来自哪一段？哪些部位已经有人看过，哪些从来没人看过？
hint.en: What does black stool tell you about where the blood comes from — and which parts of his gut have been looked at, and which never have?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问他：黑便什么时候开始、这些年怎样反复、这次怎么又发作、以前做过哪些检查、用过什么药。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask him when the black stools began, how they have come and gone, how this bout started, which tests he has had and which medicines he has tried.

title.en: Examine him and read the admission tests

hint.zh-CN: 他的循环还撑得住吗？哪些化验结果会决定你处理得多急、怎样处理才安全？
hint.en: Is his circulation coping — and which results will decide how urgently, and how safely, you treat him?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁看面色、测心率、听心脏、查腹部、肝脾和双下肢；建立静脉通路，送血常规、粪便隐血、凝血功能、铁代谢和交叉配血，在床旁或病历终端查看结果。
guidance.en: At the bedside look at his colour, take his heart rate, listen to his heart, and examine his abdomen, liver, spleen and legs; place a cannula and send the blood count, faecal occult blood, clotting, iron studies and a crossmatch, then read the results at the bedside or a records terminal.

hint.zh-CN: 他的贫血是怎样形成的？这对纠正它的速度意味着什么？接下来，出血点最可能藏在哪里？
hint.en: How did his anaemia develop, and what does that mean for how fast you correct it? Then, where is the bleeding most likely to be hiding?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 1 和 2，并在床旁把贫血的处理付诸行动；之后病例进入寻找出血部位的阶段。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and put your plan for the anaemia into action at the bedside; the case then moves on to the search for the source.

title.zh-CN: 找到出血部位并定下治疗
title.en: Locate the source and choose the treatment

hint.zh-CN: 每项检查各能回答什么问题、回答不了什么？哪种处理能一次解决问题，开始之前又必须具备什么条件？
hint.en: What can each study answer, and what can it not? Which treatment solves the problem in one go, and what must be in place before it starts?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅两份核素显像报告，送他去做腹部增强 CT 并阅读结果；作答决策 3 和 4，然后安排你选择的治疗。
guidance.en: Read the two nuclear medicine reports, take him for the contrast CT and read it; answer decisions 3 and 4, then arrange the treatment you have chosen.

title.en: Review the operation and plan follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 这个病理名称按今天的分类该怎么理解？这对他以后会不会再出血、需要怎样随访意味着什么？
hint.en: What would today's classification call this pathology label — and what does that mean for further bleeding and the follow-up he needs?

guidance.zh-CN: 问问他术后感觉，调阅手术记录和病理报告，作答决策 5，并开出补铁和随访计划。
guidance.en: Ask how he has been since the operation, read the operation note and the pathology report, answer decision 5, and prescribe iron and the follow-up plan.

hint.zh-CN: 他的实际病程在哪些地方和你的计划一致，哪些地方不同？还有什么至今不知道？
hint.en: Where did his recorded course match your plan, where did it differ — and what is still unknown?

guidance.zh-CN: 到病历终端阅读他的病程与转归记录。
guidance.en: At a records terminal, read the record of his course and outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 冯清和，12岁，这一个月又出现黑便。查体：重度贫血貌，心率 100 次/分，心前区 Ⅱ/6 级收缩期杂音，腹软，肝、脾未触及，双下肢无水肿。血红蛋白 28 g/L，红细胞 1.81×10¹²/L，血小板 363×10⁹/L；粪便隐血 ++；凝血功能正常。现在怎样处理他的贫血？
prompt.en: Feng Qinghe, 12, has had black stools again this past month. He looks severely anaemic; heart rate 100/min; a grade II/6 systolic murmur over the precordium; abdomen soft, liver and spleen not palpable, no leg oedema. Haemoglobin 28 g/L, red cells 1.81×10¹²/L, platelets 363×10⁹/L; faecal occult blood ++; clotting normal. What do you do about his anaemia now?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次发作的经过，完成查体（面色、心率、心脏、腹部、肝脾、双下肢），并查看血常规、粪便隐血和凝血功能。
need.en: First establish this bout's story, examine him (colour, heart rate, heart, abdomen, liver and spleen, legs) and read the blood count, faecal occult blood and clotting.

text.zh-CN: 配血后缓慢分次输注红细胞，每份按体重计算，每份输完复评有无循环超负荷，稳定后补铁
text.en: Crossmatch and transfuse red cells slowly in weight-based aliquots, checking for circulatory overload after each, then start iron

feedback.zh-CN: 对。血红蛋白 28 g/L 时氧供储备极少，需要现在就输红细胞；但慢慢形成的贫血伴有代偿性扩张的血容量，安全的做法是按体重小量分次、缓慢输注，每次输后复评（NICE NG24，2015；BSH 2016 儿童输血指南）。铁剂随后补足储备，单靠铁剂升不了那么快。
feedback.en: Right. At a haemoglobin of 28 g/L his oxygen-delivery reserve is minimal and he needs red cells now, but slowly developed anaemia comes with an expanded plasma volume: small weight-based aliquots, run slowly and reassessed after each, are the safe way (NICE NG24, 2015; BSH 2016 paediatric transfusion guideline). Iron then refills the stores; on its own it cannot lift the haemoglobin fast enough.

text.zh-CN: 配血后 1 小时内输入红细胞 20 mL/kg，并重复输注，把血红蛋白尽快升到正常范围再做检查
text.en: Crossmatch and give 20 mL/kg of red cells over an hour, repeating it until his haemoglobin is back in the normal range before any tests

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。慢性重度贫血时快速大量输血，是输血相关循环超负荷的典型诱因：心脏已在加速工作（心率 100 次/分、收缩期杂音），再快速扩容可致肺水肿。NICE NG24（2015）建议没有活动性出血时每次一个单位（儿童按体重折算）并复评，不需要一下子补到正常。
feedback.en: No. A fast, large transfusion in chronic severe anaemia is the classic route to transfusion-associated circulatory overload: his heart is already working hard (rate 100/min, a systolic murmur), and rapid expansion can tip him into pulmonary oedema. NICE NG24 (2015) advises one unit at a time (weight-equivalent in children) with reassessment when there is no active bleeding; there is no need to reach normal at once.

text.zh-CN: 他目前代偿良好，暂不输血，先静脉补铁，一周后复查血常规，等血红蛋白自己回升
text.en: Hold off transfusion while he is compensated: give intravenous iron now and recheck the count in a week as it rises

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。静脉铁剂要几周才能明显升高血红蛋白，不是几小时；他仍在失血（粪便隐血 ++），28 g/L 时没有等待的余地。铁剂应在谨慎输血让他脱离危险之后接着用，而不是代替输血；NICE NG24（2015）对没有活动性出血的患者，用的正是按单位（儿童按体重折算）输注、每次复评的办法。
feedback.en: No. Intravenous iron raises the haemoglobin over weeks, not hours; he is still losing blood (faecal occult blood ++), and at 28 g/L there is no reserve to wait with. Iron follows a cautious transfusion rather than replacing it; for a patient without active bleeding NICE NG24 (2015) transfuses one unit (a weight-equivalent volume in a child) at a time with reassessment, which is how to make him safe while iron takes effect.

text.zh-CN: 开口服铁剂和原来的药让他回家，门诊预约小肠检查，黑便加重时再住院
text.en: Send him home on oral iron and his usual medicines, book small-bowel tests in clinic and readmit him if the bleeding worsens

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。血红蛋白 28 g/L、仍有隐性失血、出血来源不明，回家后下一次出血几乎没有代偿余地；奥美拉唑和云南白药他已经间断用过、效果不佳。他需要住院纠正贫血并检查小肠（ESGE 2022）。
feedback.en: No. With a haemoglobin of 28 g/L, ongoing occult loss and an unknown source, the next bleed at home would find almost no reserve, and omeprazole and Yunnan Baiyao have already failed him. He needs admission, correction of the anaemia and a small-bowel search (ESGE 2022).

text.zh-CN: 今天就送手术室剖腹探查找出血点，术中边输血边纠正贫血，不必再等定位检查
text.en: Take him to theatre today for an exploratory laparotomy to find the bleeding point, transfusing during the operation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。现在还不知道出血在哪里——胃镜、结肠镜和 CT 都是阴性——而在血红蛋白 28 g/L 时手术，麻醉和术中失血都没有储备。先纠正贫血、再定位来源；记录中的团队也是先纠正贫血再手术。
feedback.en: No. Nothing yet shows where he bleeds — gastroscopy, colonoscopy and CT were negative — and operating at a haemoglobin of 28 g/L leaves no reserve for anaesthesia or blood lost in theatre. Correct the anaemia, then localise the source; the recorded team also corrected his anaemia before operating.

prompt.zh-CN: 他的黑便已反复 8 年；多家医院的胃镜、结肠镜和腹部 CT 都没找到原因，奥美拉唑和云南白药效果不佳；这次粪便隐血 ++。寻找出血来源，现在应该安排哪些检查？（多选）
prompt.en: Black stools have recurred for eight years; gastroscopy, colonoscopy and abdominal CT at several hospitals found no cause, and omeprazole and Yunnan Baiyao did not help. His faecal occult blood is ++ now. Which studies belong in the search for the source now? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，问清黑便最早何时开始、以前做过的检查和用过的药，并调阅外院检查记录。
need.en: First answer decision 1, establish when the black stools began and which tests and medicines he has had, and read the earlier hospitals' reports.

text.zh-CN: 异位胃黏膜显像（锝-99m 高锝酸盐扫描，查找梅克尔憩室）
text.en: A technetium-99m pertechnetate scan for ectopic gastric mucosa (a Meckel scan)

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。儿童不明原因的消化道出血要想到梅克尔憩室，它的出血多来自异位胃黏膜；高锝酸盐显像无创、可快速完成（ACG 2015 对年轻患者的小肠出血也提到这一检查）。阴性结果降低但不能排除这种可能。
feedback.en: Include. In a child with unexplained gastrointestinal bleeding, think of a Meckel diverticulum, whose bleeding usually comes from ectopic gastric mucosa; a pertechnetate scan finds it non-invasively (ACG 2015 also lists it for small-bowel bleeding in younger patients). A negative scan lowers that possibility without removing it.

text.zh-CN: 小肠增强 CT（CT 小肠成像），同时看有无肿块或肠腔狭窄
text.en: Contrast-enhanced CT of the small bowel (CT enterography), which also shows a mass or a narrowing

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。小肠增强 CT 能显示肠壁、肿块和血管性病变，放在胶囊内镜之前做还能发现可能卡住胶囊的狭窄；ACG 2015 把 CT 小肠成像列为疑似小肠出血检查中与胶囊内镜互补的一项。外院普通腹部 CT 阴性，不等于专门的小肠检查也会阴性。
feedback.en: Include. Contrast CT of the small bowel shows the wall, masses and vascular lesions and, done before a capsule, reveals a narrowing that could trap it; ACG 2015 places CT enterography beside capsule endoscopy in the work-up of suspected small-bowel bleeding. A negative routine abdominal CT elsewhere does not make a dedicated small-bowel study negative.

text.zh-CN: 小肠胶囊内镜，前提是没有提示肠腔狭窄、胶囊可能滞留的情况
text.en: Small-bowel capsule endoscopy, provided nothing suggests a narrowing that could hold the capsule

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ESGE 2022 指南推荐小肠胶囊内镜作为疑似小肠出血的一线检查（显性出血后最好 48 小时内完成），并用器械辅助小肠镜确认和治疗胶囊发现的病变；ESPGHAN/ESGE 2017 儿童内镜指南同样支持在能吞服胶囊的儿童中使用。
feedback.en: Include. ESGE 2022 recommends small-bowel capsule endoscopy as the first-line test for suspected small-bowel bleeding (ideally within 48 hours of an overt bleed) and device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat what it finds; the ESPGHAN/ESGE 2017 paediatric endoscopy guideline supports it in children able to swallow the capsule.

text.zh-CN: 再做一次胃镜和结肠镜，两者都正常就结束检查
text.en: Another gastroscopy and colonoscopy, ending the search if both are normal again

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。前几次检查不完整时可以复查胃镜或结肠镜，但正常结果不能结束寻找：两者够不到的小肠还从来没人看过（ESGE 2022；ACG 2015）。
feedback.en: Exclude. A repeat gastroscopy or colonoscopy can be justified when earlier ones were incomplete, but normal results cannot end the search: the small bowel, beyond the reach of both, has never been examined (ESGE 2022; ACG 2015).

text.zh-CN: 先做标记红细胞显像作为第一项定位检查，不论当时是否在出血
text.en: A labelled red-cell scan as the first localising test, whether or not he is bleeding at the time

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选（作为第一项）。标记红细胞显像只能显示检查期间仍在出血或积聚的血液，而且只能定位到腹部的某个区域，不能定位到具体肠段；它适用于显性活动性出血（ACG 2015），不是间断隐性出血的首选。他的病历里确实有一份这样的显像，读到时看看它补充了什么。
feedback.en: Exclude as a first test. A labelled red-cell scan shows only blood that is leaking or pooling during the scan, and places it in a region of the abdomen rather than a segment of bowel; it suits overt active bleeding (ACG 2015), not the first look at intermittent occult loss. His record does hold such a scan — see what it adds when you read it.

prompt.zh-CN: 定位检查结果：异位胃黏膜显像阴性；标记红细胞显像见较固定的放射性浓集；腹部增强 CT 示空肠约 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm 肿块，门静脉期明显强化，伴点状钙化。最可能的出血来源是什么？
prompt.en: The localisation studies: the ectopic gastric mucosa scan is negative; the labelled red-cell scan shows a relatively fixed focus of tracer; contrast-enhanced CT shows a jejunal mass of about 2.0 × 3.5 cm that enhances markedly in the portal venous phase, with punctate calcification. What is the most likely source of his bleeding?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 2，并在本阶段调阅两份核素显像报告、阅读腹部增强 CT。
need.en: First answer decision 2, then read the two nuclear medicine reports and the contrast CT in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 空肠的血管性病变（如海绵状血管瘤，即静脉畸形），间断出血
text.en: A vascular lesion of the jejunum, such as a cavernous haemangioma (a venous malformation), bleeding on and off

feedback.zh-CN: 对。门静脉期明显强化的空肠肿块、伴点状钙化（此时常为静脉石）、标记红细胞显像上较固定的血池浓集，加上从幼年起的反复出血，都符合慢血流的血管性病变；最终要靠病理确认。按 ISSVA 2018 分类，长期被叫作“海绵状血管瘤”的病变，在多数部位其实是静脉畸形，而不是真正的血管肿瘤。
feedback.en: Right. A jejunal mass enhancing markedly into the portal venous phase, with punctate calcification (in this setting often phleboliths), a relatively fixed blood-pool focus on the red-cell scan and bleeding since early childhood all fit a slow-flow vascular lesion; histology must confirm it. Under the ISSVA classification (2018), lesions long called 'cavernous haemangioma' are, in most sites, venous malformations rather than true vascular tumours.

text.zh-CN: 显像漏诊的梅克尔憩室，由其中的异位胃黏膜出血，空肠肿块只是另一处偶然发现
text.en: A Meckel diverticulum missed by the scan, bleeding from its ectopic gastric mucosa, with the jejunal mass an incidental finding

feedback.zh-CN: 可能性小。异位胃黏膜显像阴性虽不能完全排除梅克尔憩室，但憩室位于回肠，而 CT 所见的强化、钙化肿块在空肠；用“偶然发现”打发一个会强化的肿块，会漏掉真正的出血来源。
feedback.en: Unlikely. A negative scan does not wholly exclude a Meckel diverticulum, but one arises in the ileum, while the enhancing, calcified mass on CT is in the jejunum; calling an enhancing mass incidental would miss the real source.

text.zh-CN: 空肠胃肠间质瘤，表面黏膜溃破后反复出血
text.en: A gastrointestinal stromal tumour of the jejunum bleeding from an ulcerated surface

feedback.zh-CN: 有可能，但可能性较小。间质瘤也是会强化、会出血的黏膜下肿块，但在儿童少见；点状钙化和血池显像上的浓集更支持血管性病变。两者最终靠病理区分——这也是对看起来像血管性的肿块宁可切除、不做活检的理由之一。
feedback.en: Possible but less likely. A GIST is also an enhancing, bleeding submucosal mass, but it is rare in children, and punctate calcification with blood-pool uptake favours a vascular lesion. Only histology separates them — one reason to resect, not biopsy, a mass that looks vascular.

text.zh-CN: 空肠淋巴瘤浸润肠壁，形成肿块并反复渗血
text.en: A lymphoma of the jejunum infiltrating the wall and oozing blood

feedback.zh-CN: 可能性小。小肠淋巴瘤多表现为一段肠壁增厚，治疗前很少钙化；八年来间断出血、其间多次检查阴性，也不像淋巴瘤的病程。
feedback.en: Unlikely. Small-bowel lymphoma usually thickens a length of bowel wall and rarely calcifies before treatment, and eight years of intermittent bleeding between negative examinations is not its natural history.

text.zh-CN: 小肠多发血管扩张（血管发育不良）出血，CT 所见肿块与出血无关
text.en: Multiple angioectasias of the small bowel, with the mass on CT unrelated to the bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 可能性小。血管扩张是扁平的黏膜病变，CT 很难显示，也不会形成 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm 的强化肿块；标记红细胞显像的浓集也较固定在一处。
feedback.en: Unlikely. Angioectasias are flat mucosal lesions that CT rarely shows; they do not form a 2.0 × 3.5 cm enhancing mass, and the red-cell focus was relatively fixed in one place.

prompt.zh-CN: 工作诊断：空肠的血管性病变（如海绵状血管瘤或静脉畸形）反复出血。入院时血红蛋白 28 g/L。你计划怎样做确定性治疗、在什么时候做？
prompt.en: Working diagnosis: a bleeding vascular lesion of the jejunum, such as a cavernous haemangioma or venous malformation. His haemoglobin was 28 g/L on admission. What definitive treatment do you plan, and when?

text.zh-CN: 贫血纠正后择期手术，切除病变空肠段并一期吻合，术中检查全部小肠有无其他病灶
text.en: Once the anaemia is corrected, resect the affected jejunal segment with a primary anastomosis and check the whole small bowel

feedback.zh-CN: 对。这样大小的孤立出血性血管病变，在贫血纠正后切除病变肠段、一期吻合即可根治；术中检查全部小肠（有条件时术中内镜），是因为这类病变可以多发。记录中的团队也是先纠正贫血，再行空肠部分切除吻合。
feedback.en: Right. A solitary bleeding vascular lesion of this size is cured by resecting the segment with a primary anastomosis once the anaemia is corrected; the whole small bowel is examined at operation (with intraoperative enteroscopy where available) because such lesions can be multiple. The recorded team likewise corrected his anaemia and then resected the jejunal segment.

text.zh-CN: 经双气囊小肠镜对病灶做氩离子凝固治疗，效果不好再考虑手术切除
text.en: Argon plasma coagulation of the lesion through a double-balloon enteroscope, keeping surgery for a failed endoscopic treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。器械辅助小肠镜下的凝固治疗适用于血管扩张等小的黏膜血管病变（ESGE 2022）；一个 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm 的强化肿块无法安全地烧灼掉，反而有穿孔和大出血的风险。小肠镜可以在术前标记病灶位置，但不能代替切除。
feedback.en: No. Coagulation through device-assisted enteroscopy treats small mucosal vascular lesions such as angioectasias (ESGE 2022); a 2.0 × 3.5 cm enhancing mass cannot be ablated safely and risks perforation or major bleeding. Enteroscopy can mark the site before surgery, not replace it.

text.zh-CN: 按血管瘤口服普萘洛尔 3 个月，复查 CT 看肿块是否缩小再决定
text.en: Oral propranolol for three months as for a haemangioma, then a repeat CT to see whether the mass has shrunk

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。普萘洛尔是需要治疗的婴儿血管瘤的一线全身用药（AAP 2019），针对婴儿期增殖的血管肿瘤；12岁孩子肠道里的这种病变不是它的适应证，而且在严重贫血时，β 受体阻滞剂会削弱他靠心率维持的代偿。
feedback.en: No. Propranolol is the first-line systemic treatment for infantile haemangiomas that need treatment (AAP 2019) — tumours that grow in infancy; a lesion like this in a 12-year-old's bowel is not its indication, and in severe anaemia beta-blockade blunts the heart-rate response he depends on.

text.zh-CN: 对病灶做小剂量放射治疗，使它萎缩，免得切除一段肠管
text.en: Low-dose radiotherapy to shrink the lesion and spare him a bowel resection

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。放疗曾经用于血管瘤，如今已被弃用：照射儿童腹部会带来放射性肠炎和远期第二肿瘤的风险，而切除就能根治孤立的病灶。按 ISSVA 2018 分类，这类慢血流血管畸形今天靠切除、硬化治疗或（病变广泛时）西罗莫司处理。
feedback.en: No. Radiotherapy was once used for haemangiomas and has been abandoned: in a child it brings radiation enteritis and a later second-cancer risk, while resection cures a solitary lesion. Slow-flow malformations, as ISSVA (2018) classifies them, are managed today by excision, sclerotherapy or, when extensive, sirolimus.

text.zh-CN: 口服西罗莫司 6 个月控制病灶，期间按需输血，之后复查 CT 再决定是否手术
text.en: Sirolimus for six months to control the lesion, transfusing as needed, then a repeat CT before any decision on surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。西罗莫司用于无法切除的广泛或多发慢血流畸形（如蓝色橡皮疱样痣综合征）；一个可切除、已经把血红蛋白拖到 28 g/L 的孤立病灶，用几个月的免疫抑制换来的只是推迟根治。先按 ISSVA 2018 分类判断病变的范围，再选治疗。
feedback.en: No. Sirolimus is for extensive or multifocal slow-flow malformations that cannot be removed, such as blue rubber bleb naevus syndrome; for one resectable lesion that has already brought his haemoglobin to 28 g/L, months of immunosuppression only delay the cure. Classify the extent first (ISSVA 2018), then choose.

prompt.zh-CN: 手术所见：屈氏韧带远侧约 5 cm 处见 5 cm × 3 cm × 3 cm 暗红色结节状肿物，行空肠部分切除吻合术。病理：海绵状血管瘤，伴出血及钙化。从现在起，他的计划应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: At operation a dark-red nodular mass of 5 × 3 × 3 cm lay about 5 cm distal to the ligament of Treitz; a partial jejunal resection with anastomosis was done. Histology: cavernous haemangioma with haemorrhage and calcification. What belongs in his plan from here? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 4，并调阅手术记录和病理报告。
need.en: First answer decision 4, then read the operation note and the pathology report.

text.zh-CN: 继续口服铁剂，直到血红蛋白和铁蛋白恢复，出院后数周复查血常规
text.en: Oral iron until his haemoglobin and ferritin have recovered, with a blood count a few weeks after discharge

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。切除去掉了出血来源，却补不回亏空的铁：口服铁剂要持续到血红蛋白和储存铁（血清铁蛋白）恢复，出院后复查血常规确认疗效。NICE NG24（2015）也建议术前术后用口服铁剂纠正缺铁性贫血。
feedback.en: Include. Resection removes the source, not the deficit: oral iron should continue until the haemoglobin and the iron stores (serum ferritin) have recovered, with a blood count after discharge to confirm the response. NICE NG24 (2015) likewise advises oral iron before and after surgery for iron-deficiency anaemia.

text.zh-CN: 检查皮肤，询问其他部位有无类似病变，因为静脉畸形可以多发
text.en: Examine his skin and ask about other lesions, because venous malformations can be multiple

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。静脉畸形可以多发——例如蓝色橡皮疱样痣综合征，病变同时见于皮肤和整个消化道；本病例没有记录是否检查过他的皮肤，也没有记录术中是否看过全部小肠（ISSVA 2018 分类）。
feedback.en: Include. Venous malformations can be multiple — in blue rubber bleb naevus syndrome they appear on the skin and throughout the gut — and this case records neither a skin examination nor whether the whole small bowel was seen at operation (ISSVA 2018 classification).

text.zh-CN: 教会他和家属：再出现黑便或面色苍白就回来，再检查小肠
text.en: Teach him and his family to come back if black stools or pallor return, so the small bowel is examined again

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。再次出现黑便或面色苍白时，要重新检查小肠——ESGE 2022 推荐胶囊内镜作为一线检查，器械辅助小肠镜确认和治疗——而不是只再做一轮胃镜和结肠镜。本病例没有记录他出院后是否再出血。
feedback.en: Include. If black stools or pallor return, the small bowel needs looking at again — capsule endoscopy first-line, device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat (ESGE 2022) — rather than another round of gastroscopy and colonoscopy alone. This case does not record whether he bled again.

text.zh-CN: 口服普萘洛尔半年，防止血管瘤再长出来
text.en: Propranolol for six months to stop the haemangioma growing back

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。普萘洛尔治疗的是增殖期的婴儿血管瘤（AAP 2019），不能预防静脉畸形复发；对已经切除的这类病变没有作用，只增加低血压、低血糖和心动过缓等不良反应的风险。
feedback.en: Exclude. Propranolol treats proliferating infantile haemangiomas (AAP 2019); it does not prevent a venous malformation from recurring and has no role after resection of a lesion like his, adding only the risks of hypotension, hypoglycaemia and bradycardia.

text.zh-CN: 即使没有症状，也每 6 个月复查一次腹部增强 CT，持续 5 年
text.en: Contrast CT of the abdomen every six months for five years, even if he stays well

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。没有问题要回答的定期 CT，只会让一个正在生长的孩子反复接受辐射；只有出血或贫血复发时才需要再检查，届时首选小肠胶囊内镜（ESGE 2022）。
feedback.en: Exclude. Scheduled CT without a question to answer exposes a growing child to repeated radiation; re-investigate only if bleeding or anaemia recurs, and then with capsule endoscopy first (ESGE 2022).

text.zh-CN: 问清黑便的来龙去脉：八年前低热后起病及当时的脐周痛、此后反复、这一个月再发、外院做过的检查和用过的药
text.en: Took the bleeding story: onset after a low-grade fever eight years ago with periumbilical pain at the time, recurrences since, this month's relapse, and the earlier tests and medicines

text.zh-CN: 输血和手术前问了过敏史、既往输血、其他用药（如止痛药），以及家人和他皮肤上有无类似出血或青紫色病变
text.en: Before transfusion and surgery, asked about allergies, earlier transfusions, other medicines such as painkillers, and bleeding or bluish lesions in the family or on his skin

text.zh-CN: 看了面色、测了心率、听了心脏，触诊腹部和肝脾，并检查双下肢有无水肿
text.en: Looked at his colour, took his heart rate, listened to his heart, felt his abdomen, liver and spleen and checked his legs for oedema

text.zh-CN: 查看了血常规、粪便隐血和凝血功能，并送了铁代谢和交叉配血
text.en: Read the blood count, faecal occult blood and clotting, and sent iron studies and a crossmatch

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择缓慢分次输血，并为输血安排了床旁监护和观察
text.en: Chose slow, divided transfusion at the first attempt and set up bedside monitoring and observations for it

text.zh-CN: 读过血常规之后、手术之前，实际开始了缓慢分次的红细胞输注
text.en: Actually started a slow, divided red-cell transfusion after reading the blood count and before the operation

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把寻找方向转向小肠，并在定位阶段读了两份核素显像报告和增强 CT
text.en: Turned the search to the small bowel at the first attempt and, in the localisation phase, read both nuclear medicine reports and the contrast CT

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把各项定位结果综合为空肠的血管性病变
text.en: Put the localisation results together as a vascular lesion of the jejunum at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择贫血纠正后切除病变肠段，取得同意后安排手术，且没有用放疗或普萘洛尔代替
text.en: Chose resection after the anaemia was corrected at the first attempt, booked it with consent, and used neither radiotherapy nor propranolol instead

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定好术后计划，并开出补铁和随访安排
text.en: Set the plan after the operation at the first attempt and prescribed iron and the follow-up arrangements

text.zh-CN: 没有快速大量输血，没有在贫血纠正前安排手术，也没有让他带着重度贫血出院
text.en: Did not run a rapid large-volume transfusion, book the operation before the anaemia was corrected, or send him home with severe anaemia

text.zh-CN: 向孩子和家属解释输血、检查和手术，取得孩子本人的同意和家属的知情同意
text.en: Explained the transfusion, the tests and the operation to him and his family, seeking his assent and their informed consent

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、采集信息、解释与计划、结束）：向孩子和家属自我介绍，主要对孩子本人说话，用 12 岁孩子听得懂的话；在家属同意下留出一段单独谈话，并说明哪些内容会保密、哪些不能。用通俗的话解释：他的血红蛋白很低，是因为肠子里某个地方反复慢慢出血；输血要慢、要分几次，是为了让心脏跟得上；接下来的检查各查什么。手术前说明要切掉一小段带病变的肠子再接起来、主要风险和术后注意事项，取得他本人的同意和家属的知情同意。坦诚回应他“是不是又要抽很多血”的担心，不作虚假保证，不承诺以后一定不再出血（本病例没有记录远期随访）；请他用自己的话复述，留出提问时间。不编造病例中没有的检查结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves to him and his family and speaks mainly to him, in words a 12-year-old understands; with the family's agreement offers part of the conversation alone with him and says what stays confidential and what cannot. Explains in plain words that his blood count is very low because he has been bleeding slowly, on and off, somewhere in his gut; that the transfusion goes in slowly, in several parts, so his heart can keep up; and what each of the next tests looks for. Before the operation explains that a short piece of bowel with the lesion will be removed and the ends joined, the main risks and what to expect afterwards, and seeks his assent and the family's informed consent. Answers his worry about more needles honestly, without false reassurance or a promise that the bleeding will never return (no long-term follow-up is recorded); checks understanding by asking him to say it back in his own words and leaves room for questions. Invents no result the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 入院交班（ISBAR）：12岁男孩，黑便、面色苍白反复 8 年，近 1 个月再发，收入儿科病房；入院查体心率 100 次/分，其余生命体征没有可报的记录。病房有床旁监护仪和治疗车（留置针、采血管），血制品由输血科送到床旁；CT 室和内镜室在影像区，要用推床送他过去；核素显像报告进电子病历，可在护士站的病历终端调阅。复述医嘱，完成护理范围内的操作（静脉通路、输血核对和输血期间的观察）；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到血压、体温、体重或过敏情况时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。陪床的是孩子的一位近亲属，签字前想先弄清楚风险。
knowledge.en: Admission handover (ISBAR): a 12-year-old boy with eight years of recurrent black stools and pallor, back again over the last month, admitted to the children's ward; heart rate 100/min on admission, with nothing else recorded to report for his vital signs. The ward has bedside monitors and a treatment cart (cannulas, sample tubes); blood products come to the bedside from the blood bank; the CT scanner and the endoscopy suite are in the imaging area and he goes there on a trolley; nuclear medicine reports arrive in the electronic record, readable at the nurses' station terminal. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks (IV access, the bedside checks and observations of a transfusion); reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses; asked for his blood pressure, temperature, weight or allergies, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number. A close relative is staying with him and wants to understand the risks before signing anything.

name.zh-CN: 沈医生（儿科消化主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“黑便说明血在肠道里停留了多久、大致来自哪一段？”“胃镜和结肠镜各能看到哪里？两者之间还剩哪一段没人看过？”“这样低的血红蛋白是几周里慢慢降下来的，还是一下子降的？这对输血速度意味着什么？”“为什么不能只靠补铁等它升上来？”“异位胃黏膜显像、标记红细胞显像和增强 CT 各回答什么问题？”“门静脉期强化加上点状钙化，你会想到什么？”“手术之前必须先具备什么条件？”“‘海绵状血管瘤’这个病理名称，按今天的分类该怎么理解？”。可以讲解 ESGE 2022、ACG 2015、NICE NG24（2015）、BSH 2016 儿童输血指南、AAP 2019 和 ISSVA 2018 分类的相关原则；学员读到相应记录之后，可以对比记录中的做法（骨髓检查确认缺铁、核素显像和增强 CT 定位、先纠正贫血再切除）与现行做法（血清铁蛋白、胶囊内镜一线、按体重分次输血、ISSVA 命名）。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例没有的资料（血压、体温、体重、红细胞指数、铁蛋白、纠正贫血的方法、手术入路和出院后的随访都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “How long has blood been in the gut to turn the stool black, and roughly where does that put it?”, “Where do a gastroscope and a colonoscope reach — and which stretch between them has nobody seen?”, “Did a haemoglobin this low fall over weeks or overnight, and what does that mean for how fast you transfuse?”, “Why not simply give iron and wait?”, “What question does each of the ectopic gastric mucosa scan, the red-cell scan and the contrast CT answer?”, “Portal-venous enhancement with punctate calcification — what does that make you think of?”, “What must be in place before he goes to theatre?”, “What would today's classification call a ‘cavernous haemangioma’?”. May explain the relevant principles of ESGE 2022, ACG 2015, NICE NG24 (2015), the BSH 2016 paediatric transfusion guideline, AAP 2019 and the ISSVA 2018 classification and, once the learner has read the records, contrast the recorded practice (a marrow to show iron deficiency, nuclear scans and contrast CT to localise, anaemia corrected before resection) with current practice (serum ferritin, capsule endoscopy first-line, weight-based divided transfusion, ISSVA naming). Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (blood pressure, temperature, weight, red-cell indices, ferritin, how the anaemia was corrected, the surgical approach and the follow-up after discharge are not recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经读过的影像和核素报告：异位胃黏膜显像查找的是什么，阴性结果的意义和局限；标记红细胞显像只显示检查期间仍在出血或积聚的血液，只能定位到腹部的某个区域；增强 CT 上门静脉期明显强化和点状钙化（常为静脉石）提示慢血流的血管性病变，以及与间质瘤、淋巴瘤和血管扩张的鉴别；外院普通腹部 CT 与专门的小肠检查有什么不同；学员两份都读过之后，CT 测得的大小为什么会和术中测量不同。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造扫描方案、动脉期表现、浓集部位或其他病灶（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the imaging and nuclear medicine reports the learner has read: what an ectopic gastric mucosa scan looks for and what a negative result does and does not mean; that a labelled red-cell scan shows only blood leaking or pooling during the scan and localises to a region of the abdomen; that marked portal-venous enhancement with punctate calcification (often phleboliths) on contrast CT suggests a slow-flow vascular lesion, and how it differs from a GIST, lymphoma or angioectasia; how a routine abdominal CT elsewhere differs from a dedicated small-bowel study; and, once the learner has read both, why a size measured on CT can differ from the one measured at operation. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents the scan protocol, the arterial-phase appearance, the site of the tracer focus or other lesions (none is recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 接到会诊后参与。只解读学员已经读过的 CT、手术记录和病理报告：为什么先纠正贫血再手术；切除病变肠段并一期吻合；术中检查全部小肠、有条件时用术中内镜寻找其他病灶；向孩子和家属说明手术、取得同意的要点。不编造手术入路、切除长度、切缘、术中出血或术后并发症（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Joins once asked to consult. Interprets only the CT, the operation note and the pathology report the learner has read: why the anaemia is corrected before the operation; resection of the affected segment with a primary anastomosis; examining the whole small bowel at operation, with intraoperative enteroscopy where available, for other lesions; and how to explain the operation to him and his family and obtain consent. Never invents the approach, the length resected, the margins, operative blood loss or complications (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：多年黑便的孩子——安全地纠正贫血，再到小肠里找出血点
title.en: Debrief: years of black stools in a child — correct the anaemia safely, then search the small bowel

conclusion.zh-CN: 12岁男孩，8 年前一次低热后开始黑便，伴脐周阵发性痛和面色苍白，此后反复；多家医院的胃镜、结肠镜和腹部 CT 未明确原因，奥美拉唑和云南白药效果不佳，近 1 个月再发。入院时重度贫血貌，心率 100 次/分，心前区 Ⅱ/6 级收缩期杂音；血红蛋白 28 g/L，红细胞 1.81×10¹²/L，血小板 363×10⁹/L，粪便隐血 ++，凝血功能正常，骨髓呈缺铁表现。异位胃黏膜显像阴性，标记红细胞显像见较固定的放射性浓集，增强 CT 示空肠约 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm 肿块，门静脉期明显强化伴点状钙化。先纠正贫血，再切除屈氏韧带远侧约 5 cm 处 5 cm × 3 cm × 3 cm 的暗红色结节状肿物并行空肠吻合；病理为海绵状血管瘤伴出血及钙化，术后恢复良好。按今天的做法：按体重缓慢分次输血，再以胶囊内镜为一线检查寻找小肠来源（ESGE 2022），手术切除，并按 ISSVA 2018 分类理解病理名称。
conclusion.en: A 12-year-old boy had eight years of recurring black stools and pallor, beginning after a low-grade fever with periumbilical pain; gastroscopy, colonoscopy and abdominal CT at several hospitals found no cause, omeprazole and Yunnan Baiyao did not help, and it recurred last month. He looked severely anaemic, heart rate 100/min, with a grade II/6 systolic murmur; Hb 28 g/L, red cells 1.81×10¹²/L, platelets 363×10⁹/L, faecal occult blood ++, clotting normal, an iron-deficient marrow. The ectopic gastric mucosa scan was negative, a red-cell scan showed a relatively fixed focus, and CT a 2.0 × 3.5 cm jejunal mass enhancing in the portal venous phase with punctate calcification. Once his anaemia was corrected, a 5 × 3 × 3 cm mass about 5 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz was resected with an anastomosis: cavernous haemangioma with haemorrhage and calcification; he recovered well. Today: slow weight-based transfusion, a capsule-led small-bowel search (ESGE 2022), resection, ISSVA terms.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 黑便说明血在肠道里停留过、被消化过；多家医院的胃镜和结肠镜都没找到原因，两者之间那段够不到的小肠就成了首要怀疑对象。
keyReasoning.en: Black stool means blood has stayed in the gut long enough to be altered; with gastroscopy and colonoscopy at several hospitals unrevealing, the stretch between them that neither reaches — the small bowel — becomes the prime suspect.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血红蛋白 28 g/L、粪便隐血阳性、凝血正常、血小板不低，提示慢性失血，而不是出血性疾病或骨髓衰竭；骨髓的缺铁表现与此一致。
keyReasoning.en: A haemoglobin of 28 g/L with a positive faecal occult blood, normal clotting and a platelet count that is not low points to chronic blood loss rather than a bleeding disorder or marrow failure; the iron-deficient marrow agrees.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 他目前代偿——心率 100 次/分、腹软、肝脾不大、下肢不肿——所以眼下的危险不只是血红蛋白低，还包括纠正得太快。
keyReasoning.en: He is compensated — heart rate 100/min, soft abdomen, no enlarged liver or spleen, no leg oedema — so the danger of the moment is not only the low haemoglobin but also correcting it too fast.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 异位胃黏膜显像阴性让梅克尔憩室的可能性降低，标记红细胞显像有较固定的浓集，CT 显示空肠强化肿块伴点状钙化：三者合在一起指向空肠的血管性病变。
keyReasoning.en: The negative ectopic gastric mucosa scan makes a Meckel source less likely, the red-cell scan shows a relatively fixed focus, and CT finds an enhancing jejunal mass with punctate calcification: together they point to a vascular lesion of the jejunum.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 只有切除能同时给出组织诊断和根治；病理“海绵状血管瘤伴出血及钙化”与影像相符，而它在今天分类中的归属决定了还需要怎样随访。
keyReasoning.en: Only resection gives both the tissue diagnosis and the cure; the pathology — cavernous haemangioma with haemorrhage and calcification — fits the imaging, and where it sits in today's classification decides the follow-up he still needs.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明这类病变有多常见、各项检查有多准确或手术的远期效果；除心率外没有记录生命体征，也没有记录纠正贫血的方法、手术细节和出院后的随访。决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show how common such lesions are, how accurate each test is, or the long-term result of surgery; apart from the heart rate no vital signs are recorded, nor how the anaemia was corrected, the operative details or the follow-up after discharge. The decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 除心率外的生命体征（血压、呼吸、体温、血氧饱和度），以及体重和身高。
unknowns.en: Vital signs other than the heart rate (blood pressure, respiratory rate, temperature, oxygen saturation), and his weight and height.

unknowns.zh-CN: 红细胞指数、网织红细胞、铁蛋白和铁代谢、血型，以及已记录各项检查的参考区间。
unknowns.en: Red-cell indices, reticulocyte count, ferritin and iron studies, blood group, and the reference ranges of the recorded tests.

unknowns.en: How often and how heavily he bled over the eight years, whether he had been transfused before, and whether he had abdominal pain on this admission.

unknowns.zh-CN: 外院胃镜、结肠镜和 CT 的时间、范围和所见（例如结肠镜是否进入回肠末端）。
unknowns.en: The dates, extent and findings of the earlier gastroscopies, colonoscopies and CT (for example whether the colonoscope reached the terminal ileum).

unknowns.zh-CN: 标记红细胞显像浓集的部位、CT 的扫描方案和动脉期表现，以及从入院到手术的时间。
unknowns.en: The site of the red-cell scan focus, the CT protocol and its arterial phase, and the time from admission to the operation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 纠正贫血的方法（血制品、量和速度）、手术入路、切除长度、术中是否检查全部小肠，以及有无皮肤或其他部位的病变。
unknowns.en: How the anaemia was corrected (products, volumes, rate), the surgical approach, the length resected, whether the whole small bowel was examined, and any skin or other lesions.

unknowns.zh-CN: 过敏史、家族史、其他用药，以及出院后的补铁、随访时长和是否再出血。
unknowns.en: Allergies, family history and other medicines, and after discharge his iron treatment, the length of follow-up and whether he bled again.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 黑便而胃镜、结肠镜阴性，应按“疑似小肠出血”处理（ACG 2015 用这一术语取代“不明原因消化道出血”）。ESGE 2022 指南推荐小肠胶囊内镜作为一线检查，显性出血后最好 48 小时内完成，并用器械辅助小肠镜确认和治疗胶囊发现的病变；儿童还要考虑异位胃黏膜显像。记录与现行做法：他八年里反复做胃镜和结肠镜，这次靠核素显像和增强 CT 定位，记录中没有胶囊内镜或小肠镜。
teachingPoints.en: Black stools with a negative gastroscopy and colonoscopy are suspected small-bowel bleeding (the term ACG 2015 uses in place of 'obscure' bleeding). ESGE 2022 recommends small-bowel capsule endoscopy as the first-line test — ideally within 48 hours of an overt bleed — and device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat what it finds; in a child, add a scan for ectopic gastric mucosa. Then and now: for eight years he had upper and lower endoscopy; this admission localised the source with nuclear scans and contrast CT, and no capsule or enteroscopy is recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 慢性重度贫血要输血，但要慢。缺铁的骨髓、八年反复出血和这一个月的再发，提示贫血是慢慢形成的，血容量已代偿性扩张；快速大量输血可引起输血相关循环超负荷。NICE NG24（2015）对没有活动性出血的患者建议每次一个单位（儿童按体重折算等量）、输后复评；BSH 2016 儿童输血指南按体重计算输注量。记录与现行做法：报告写明手术前先纠正了贫血，但没有记录用的什么方法。
teachingPoints.en: Transfuse chronic severe anaemia — slowly. An iron-deficient marrow, eight years of recurrent bleeding and a month of renewed loss point to anaemia that developed slowly, with an expanded plasma volume, and a rapid large transfusion can cause transfusion-associated circulatory overload. NICE NG24 (2015) advises, when there is no active bleeding, one unit at a time (a weight-equivalent volume in children) with reassessment after each; the BSH 2016 paediatric guideline calculates volumes by weight. Then and now: the report says the anaemia was corrected before the operation, but not how.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 看清每项检查能回答什么：异位胃黏膜显像查找异位胃黏膜（梅克尔憩室出血多由此引起），阴性降低但不排除这种可能；标记红细胞显像只显示检查期间仍在出血或积聚的血液，只能定位到腹部的某个区域（ACG 2015）；增强 CT 显示肠壁和肿块——这里空肠肿块门静脉期明显强化、伴点状钙化（常为静脉石），提示慢血流的血管性病变。记录与现行做法：报告用骨髓检查确认缺铁，今天血清铁蛋白就能回答这个问题，不必穿刺。
teachingPoints.en: Know what each study can answer. A scan for ectopic gastric mucosa looks for the tissue that makes a Meckel diverticulum bleed — a negative one lowers but does not exclude it; a labelled red-cell scan shows only blood leaking or pooling during the scan and localises it to a region (ACG 2015); contrast CT shows the wall and masses — here a jejunal mass enhancing markedly in the portal venous phase with punctate calcification (often phleboliths), suggesting a slow-flow vascular lesion. Then and now: the report confirmed iron deficiency with a bone-marrow examination; today a serum ferritin answers that without a needle.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 孤立的小肠血管性病变反复出血、内镜处理不了时，手术切除病变肠段并一期吻合即可根治；术中检查全部小肠（有条件时术中内镜），因为这类病变可以多发。普萘洛尔用于需要治疗的婴儿血管瘤（AAP 2019），不适用于他；放疗曾用于血管瘤，现已弃用。记录与现行做法：报告先纠正贫血，再行空肠部分切除吻合，和今天的顺序一致。
teachingPoints.en: A solitary bleeding small-bowel vascular lesion beyond endoscopic treatment is cured by resecting the segment with a primary anastomosis; examine the whole small bowel at operation (intraoperative enteroscopy where available), because such lesions can be multiple. Propranolol is for infantile haemangiomas that need treatment (AAP 2019), not for him; radiotherapy, once used for haemangiomas, has been abandoned. Then and now: the report corrected the anaemia first and then resected the jejunal segment — the same order as today.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 用今天的名称理解病理：ISSVA 2018 分类把血管异常分为血管肿瘤（如婴儿血管瘤）和血管畸形；肠道里报告为“海绵状血管瘤”的病变，多数属于慢血流的静脉畸形。这一区分决定了：不用普萘洛尔；要想到多发病变（如蓝色橡皮疱样痣综合征）并查看皮肤；随访要补足铁储备，黑便再现时重新检查小肠（ESGE 2022：胶囊内镜一线）。记录与现行做法：报告沿用“海绵状血管瘤”的名称，没有记录术后随访。
teachingPoints.en: Name the lesion in today's terms. The ISSVA classification (2018) divides vascular anomalies into vascular tumours (such as infantile haemangioma) and vascular malformations, and most bowel lesions reported as 'cavernous haemangioma' are slow-flow venous malformations. The distinction matters: no propranolol; think of multifocal disease (blue rubber bleb naevus syndrome) and look at the skin; follow up to refill the iron stores and re-examine the small bowel if black stools return (ESGE 2022: capsule endoscopy first-line). Then and now: the report keeps the label 'cavernous haemangioma' and records no follow-up after the operation.
